name: Stipend To Law Graduates
benefit:
Under this scheme, Monthly stipend of Rs 5000 will be given for a period of 4 years.
Some training courses will also be organized under the Senior Advocates.
_eligibility_text: 1. Applicant should be a resident of Karnataka state. 1. Applicant should belong to the SC/ST Community. 1. Family income from all sources should be within Rs. 2 lakhs per annum. 1. Maximum age limit allowed is 40 years. 1. Law degree holder from any State/Central Government recognized University/Institution 1. Duration of the Law Course should be either 3 years or 5 years
